external_risk_note: No distress signals. One finance-side leadership change in May; the CFO who signed the original contract has moved on, which matters for the renewal paperwork even though nothing on the calls reflects it.

events.headline: Northwind Logistics names a new Chief Financial Officer
events.note: The outgoing CFO approved the original purchase. New finance leadership typically re-reviews vendor spend above six figures at first renewal.

external_risk_note: A flat-to-down extension round in April was followed by a 12% workforce reduction in June that included the revenue operations function. Our champion's contact record went inactive within days of that announcement.

events.headline: Bluepeak Analytics raises a $14M Series B extension at a reduced valuation
events.note: Extension rounds at a reduced price are usually followed by an operating-expense review within two quarters.

events.headline: Bluepeak Analytics cuts 12% of staff, consolidating revenue operations under marketing
events.note: The revenue operations team our engagement supports was folded into marketing. The function that bought us no longer exists as a separate org.

external_risk_note: Well funded and hiring into commercial roles. No distress signals of any kind.

events.headline: Cascadia Health Systems closes a $120M Series D to expand its commercial organisation
events.note: Fresh capital earmarked for commercial expansion. Good news, and it offsets risk rather than adding to it.

external_risk_note: Privately held, no public financing events, no leadership changes found. Nothing external is driving the frustration on this account — it is entirely a delivery-quality story.

Twenty-three months since the last raise with visible hiring contraction, and a new Chief Revenue Officer started in June who has publicly described the commercial stack as 'over-tooled'. This is the account with the least conversation coverage and the most external risk — the two facts are related.

events.headline: Solstice Robotics pauses hiring across go-to-market roles
events.note: Twenty-three months past the last round with a hiring pause is the shape of a company managing runway into a bridge.

events.headline: Solstice Robotics appoints a new Chief Revenue Officer
events.note: In a recorded podcast interview the incoming CRO said the commercial stack is 'over-tooled and under-adopted' and that she would be consolidating vendors in her first two quarters. Our renewal falls inside that window.
